messages:
aj: Quick intake check — Alder9B (open checkpoint) manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-models/alder9b/manifest.json. Need: perf owner, legal license signoff, and canary rollout plan. Can someone pick perf + do a quick pass on licensing?

maria: @aj I can own perf profiling. Quick Q: model card says max context 2048 — is that final? affects batching and cache.

aj: yep 2k is the target for now. sample prompt set is in the repo under /benchmarks/alder9b/prompts.

olivia: tagging in — I'll run baseline p50/p95 + throughput on A100 and T4 tomorrow. also want a quant-int8 run. can you drop a minimal eval script?

aj: eval script added: https://git.internal/redwood/alder9b-evals (see run.sh). example:
```bash
./run.sh --model s3://redwood-models/alder9b/fp16 --batch 1 --seq 2048 --iters 200
```

ken: infra note: model fp16 ~13GB, int8 ~6GB. if perf owner chooses int8 we'll need a quant profile artifact at s3://redwood-models/quant-profiles/alder9b/int8.json. Also enable KV cache by default for 2k contexts: "kv_cache": true. Heads up about memory spikes at long seqs on smaller cards.

maria: starting runs now. initial single-run looks like p50 ~430ms batch=1 on A100-80G (rough). I'll upload run logs to the eval bucket.

liz: glanced at license metadata in manifest: primary license Apache-2.0 but there are dataset citations. need to confirm none are CC-BY-NC or similar. I'll do a thorough check and post a note.

aj: thanks @liz. small launch ask: please add a model_card.dataset_attribution field if required. Also we should define canary plan: canary 5% for 24h, increase to 25% after 48h if no regressions; fallback to alder9b-fp16 if error rate > 1% or p95 latency doubles.

maria: will add rollout + health checks to PR. creating now -> https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/9876 

liz: confirmed — no CC-BY-NC. license clear but must include dataset attribution in model card and a short provenance note. I'll add comments on PR by EOD.

olivia: after perf runs I'll push a perf profile JSON to the perf repo and upload the quant test results. planning int8 vs fp16 latency/quality comparison.

devex-bot: :calendar: Canary window reminder set for 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC — automations will notify infra + oncall.

aj: summary/owners: perf -> maria/olivia, infra rollout prep -> ken, legal/license -> liz, PR/merge -> aj. Milestone: perf profile merged + license completed by 2026-04-05. Ping here when PR ready for final review. :thumbsup:

maria: noted, will add perf artifacts + rollback thresholds to the PR and tag reviewers.

ken: prepping infra config; will add a preflight suppression for memory spike threshold and a fallback route to alder9b-fp16.

aj: awesome — thanks everyone. if any blockers call out in this thread.
